verdict.rationale: Retell supports event-driven automation via webhooks (call_started/call_ended/call_analyzed) that push data to external systems, and function calling lets agents autonomously trigger actions (transfer, SMS, end call, custom API calls) based on conversation logic, plus AI QA evaluates calls 'against rules and metrics you configure.' This covers much of 'trigger actions on events' but there's no explicit user-facing rules/automation engine (e.g., if-this-then-that conditions across arbitrary events) — it's scattered across webhooks, function calling, and AI QA rather than a unified rule-definition system. Missing for 10: a dedicated automation/rules-engine UI or docs showing arbitrary event-condition-action definitions, and independent corroboration of automated action triggering in production.
